newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Photo forms British electronic printing unit.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Photo forms British electronic printing unit.

text.p: Fuji Photo Film Co Ltd said on Friday that it had formed a wholly owned subsidiary in Britain to develop and produce electronic printing equipment.

With FUJIFILM Electronic Imaging Ltd's establishment, Fuji and DuPont Co of the United States agreed to disband their fifty-fifty venture Crosfield Electronics Ltd (CEL) in Britain, a Fuji spokesman said.
They also agreed that Fuji's new company would acquire CEL's resources to continue CEL's operations, he said.
CEL develops and produces electronic printing equipment.
Fuji did not disclose the value of the acquisition.
The new subsidiary will start operations next March 31.
